edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] within [NUMBER] days after the parties execute this Agreement, by a payment method agreed in writing.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the full settlement payment, Plaintiff releases Defendant from the claims asserted in [IDENTIFY ACTION OR DISPUTE]. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers, as necessary to enforce this Agreement, or as required by law. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful communications with governmental or regulatory authorities.
